(rule!
 ;; Every color that appears EXACTLY TWICE with its two cells sharing a row
 ;; or a column gets the pair CONNECTED by a straight line of that color
 ;; (colors processed in ascending order; diagonal pairs stay untouched).
 (let ()
   (define (connect out color)
     (let ((cells (find-color g color)))
       (if (and (= (length cells) 2)
                (or (= (first (first cells)) (first (second cells)))
                    (= (second (first cells)) (second (second cells)))))
           (draw-line out
                      (first (first cells)) (second (first cells))
                      (first (second cells)) (second (second cells))
                      color)
           out)))
   (for/fold ((out g)) ((color (in-list (sort (grid-colors g) <))))
     (if (= color 0) out (connect out color)))))
